builtBy: Research by hand, 2026-11-13: the players' own recruiting pages (profiles[]), one entry per volleyball registry team. Hudl's public team rosters for every school's girls volleyball teams, NCSA's women's volleyball school pages, a SportsRecruits profile-address probe and MaxPreps' claimed career pages; each Hudl and NCSA page re-read by an independent refuter. No roster value is enriched by hand.
notes: profiles[] only: the players' own recruiting pages, linked by the rule of field hockey's file (lib/players/rosters-schema.ts PlayerProfileSchema): the page names the player and a sport, and either names the school or shows the roster's class year with a hometown in the school's own area. A volleyball profile names no sport; a profile in another sport does. No grade, height, number, position or coach is added by hand, and no school athletics site was swept.

2026-11-13, Hudl: every school's girls volleyball teams' public rosters (91 team-season rosters at the 40 schools Hudl lists; 23 schools have a non-empty one), matched by name, then each profile page read. Kept when the page's own team list has a volleyball team of the player's school and its class year, when shown, is the roster's. 75 rostered players have only private Hudl profiles; two pages state a class year that disagrees and are not linked.

2026-11-13, NCSA: the women's volleyball page of each of the 38 schools with players (45 pages), each matched athlete's page read. Kept when the page names the school and the roster's class year. Seven listed athletes' addresses were not found. Beach volleyball pages were not read.

2026-11-13, SportsRecruits: a profile-address probe in every sport for 870 of the 891 varsity and JV rows (4,472 addresses on my.sportsrecruits.com; 1,017 live pages, each read through the JSON the page itself loads; the kept ones read four times). About 530 live pages show at most a class year and are not linked. One page (a hyphenated surname's) was reached by the commitment-list sweep instead.
2026-11-13, MaxPreps: every row's career page read for MaxPreps' own claimed flag; a claimed page is linked as a MaxPreps profile (always the row's own careerUrl).
FieldLevel: 140 addresses probed at six schools and stopped; the four live pages show no school or class year, so none is linked.

Every Hudl and NCSA page linked was re-read by an independent refuter, who kept all of them. The SportsRecruits and MaxPreps pages were read more than once by the pass that found them, not by a second reader.
